title: Pilot Feasibility Study of a Sjögren's Syndrome Self-management App
brief_summary: This study investigates the feasibility of a fully remote effectiveness evaluation of a self-management smartphone application for those with Sjogren's syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Over 18 years of age
* Diagnosed with either Primary or Secondary Sjogren's syndrome (self-report)
* Own an iPhone or Android smartphone

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
